001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.comm.CommMessageAPI.MessageClickAction;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.EconomyAPI.EconomyUpdateListener;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.econ.PiracyRespite;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Conditions;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Sounds;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.BaseIntelPlugin;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.MessageIntel;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.rulecmd.KantaCMD;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
014
015public class PiracyRespiteScript implements EconomyUpdateListener {
016
017        public static String KEY = "$prs_ref";
018        
019        //public static float DURATION = 730;
020        public static float DURATION = -1f;
021        
022        public static PiracyRespiteScript get() {
023                //if (true) return null;
024                return (PiracyRespiteScript) Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().get(KEY);
025        }
026        
027        public static boolean playerHasPiracyRespite() {
028                return get() != null;
029        }
030        
031
032        protected long timestamp;
033        
034        public PiracyRespiteScript() {
035                sendGainedMessage();
036                
037                // to avoid duplicates
038                PiracyRespiteScript existing = get();
039                if (existing != null) {
040                        existing.resetTimestamp();
041                        return;
042                }
043                
044                resetTimestamp();
045                Global.getSector().getEconomy().addUpdateListener(this);
046                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(KEY, this);
047                
048                economyUpdated();
049        }
050        
051        public void sendGainedMessage() {
052                MessageIntel msg = new MessageIntel();
053                msg.addLine("Piracy Respite gained", Misc.getBasePlayerColor());
054                if (!PiracyRespite.NEW_MODE) {
055                        msg.addLine(BaseIntelPlugin.BULLET + "Colonies receive %s accessibility", Misc.getTextColor(),
056                                        new String [] {"+" + (int)Math.round(PiracyRespite.ACCESSIBILITY_BONUS * 100f) + "%"},
057                                        Misc.getHighlightColor());
058                        if (DURATION > 0) {
059                                msg.addLine(BaseIntelPlugin.BULLET + "Lasts for %s days", Misc.getTextColor(),
060                                                new String [] {"" + (int)PiracyRespiteScript.DURATION},
061                                        Misc.getHighlightColor());
062                        }
063                } else {
064                        msg.addLine(BaseIntelPlugin.BULLET + "Reduced shipping disruptions", Misc.getTextColor());
065                }
066                msg.setIcon(Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("events", "piracy_respite"));
067                msg.setSound(Sounds.REP_GAIN);
068                Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage(msg, MessageClickAction.COLONY_INFO);
069        }
070        
071        public void sendExpiredMessage() {
072                MessageIntel msg = new MessageIntel();
073                msg.addLine("Piracy Respite lost", Misc.getBasePlayerColor());
074                msg.setIcon(Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("events", "piracy_respite"));
075                msg.setSound(Sounds.REP_LOSS);
076                Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage(msg, MessageClickAction.COLONY_INFO);
077        }
078
079        public void resetTimestamp() {
080                timestamp = Global.getSector().getClock().getTimestamp();               
081        }
082        
083        public float getDaysRemaining() {
084                if (DURATION < 0) return DURATION;
085                float rem = DURATION - Global.getSector().getClock().getElapsedDaysSince(timestamp);
086                //rem = 1f - Global.getSector().getClock().getElapsedDaysSince(timestamp);
087                if (rem < 0) rem = 0;
088                return rem;
089        }
090
091        public void commodityUpdated(String commodityId) {
092                
093        }
094
095        public void economyUpdated() {
096                //for (MarketAPI curr : Misc.getPlayerMarkets(false)) {
097                for (MarketAPI curr : Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsCopy()) {
098                        if (curr.isPlayerOwned() && curr.getFaction() != null && curr.getFaction().isPlayerFaction()) {
099                                if (!curr.hasCondition(Conditions.PIRACY_RESPITE)) {
100                                        curr.addCondition(Conditions.PIRACY_RESPITE);
101                                }
102                        } else {
103                                if (curr.hasCondition(Conditions.PIRACY_RESPITE)) {
104                                        curr.removeCondition(Conditions.PIRACY_RESPITE);
105                                }
106                        }
107                }
108        }
109
110        public void cleanup() {
111                if (Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains(KEY)) {
112                        sendExpiredMessage();
113                }
114                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(KEY);
115                //for (MarketAPI curr : Misc.getPlayerMarkets(false)) {
116                for (MarketAPI curr : Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsCopy()) {
117                        if (curr.hasCondition(Conditions.PIRACY_RESPITE)) {
118                                curr.removeCondition(Conditions.PIRACY_RESPITE);
119                        }
120                }
121        }
122        
123        public boolean isEconomyListenerExpired() {
124                if (DURATION < 0) return false;
125                
126                float days = getDaysRemaining();
127                if (days <= 0) {
128                        cleanup();
129                        return true;
130                }
131                
132                if (!PirateHostileActivityFactor.isDefeatedLargePirateRaid() && !KantaCMD.playerHasProtection()) {
133                        cleanup();
134                        return true;
135                }
136                
137                return false;
138        }
139
140}
